hooks.name: Check bundled flow YAML on save
hooks.description: Runs check_flow for every bundled flow against the bundled signatures, compares each shipped file with Flow.to_yaml(), and runs the flow sync tests. Silent when everything passes; the report goes to standard error when it fails.

action.command: python tests/hook_pytest.py tests/unit/test_flow_bundled.py tests/unit/test_flow_sync.py tests/unit/test_flow_command_sync.py -p no:cacheprovider
